findings.title: CWE-20: Imported duration can permanently crash library
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the trapping Int conversion with finite Double formatting or Int(exactly: duration.rounded(.towardZero)) plus fallback. A completed package with duration 1e100 currently passes validation, persists successfully, then crashes library rendering on every launch. Add an import/reload regression for this package.

testing_gaps: Review was static; the malformed-duration package was not imported into a running iOS application.
